title: Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes
summary: For every nonnegative integer n , we construct a Smith–Toda complex $`V(n)`$ at some prime p depending on n . It is a finite p -local spectrum whose Brown–Peterson homology is $`\mathrm{BP}_*/(p,v_1,\ldots,v_n)`$ with its canonical comodule structure and generator in degree zero. Each listed generator is killed to its first power.
family_title: Finite Smith–Toda complexes at every height

review.reason: Constructs Smith–Toda complexes at varying primes with prescribed Brown–Peterson homology.
